meaning_en: A contemptuous term for an old-fashioned elderly person, used to insult someone elderly as stubborn, outdated, burdensome, or unwanted rather than simply describing their age.
distractor_literal_en: old one who will not die

explanation_zh: 法律或制度漏洞太大，足以让人轻易钻空子。
meaning_en: It describes a law or system with such huge loopholes that people can easily exploit them, evade restrictions, or take advantage of the rules without much difficulty.
equivalent_en: drive a coach-and-four through an Act of Parliament
distractor_literal_en: a leaking net swallows a boat

explanation_zh: 反复解释、劝说到口干舌燥。
meaning_en: It means explaining or persuading someone over and over until you are exhausted, but still having little or no effect on their thinking or behavior.
equivalent_en: talk until you're blue in the face
distractor_literal_en: wear out the skin of your mouth

explanation_zh: 准确说中问题核心。
meaning_en: It describes a statement or observation that captures the core point exactly, identifying the real issue with precision instead of circling around less important details.
equivalent_en: hit the nail on the head

term_zh: 一条活狗胜过一头死狮
explanation_zh: 活着比空有尊严或名声但已经死亡更有价值。
meaning_en: It means that staying alive and enduring is more valuable than having honor, reputation, or pride after death; survival matters more than status or pride.
equivalent_en: a living dog is better than a dead lion
distractor_literal_en: a live dog fights a dead lion

explanation_zh: 表面慈悲善良，内心却狠毒阴险。
meaning_en: It describes someone who speaks with apparent kindness and compassion, but whose gentle words conceal cruel motives, malice, or a willingness to harm others.
equivalent_en: kind words hiding a venomous heart

explanation_zh: 刚摆脱一个困境，又进入更糟的处境。
meaning_en: It describes escaping one difficult situation only to fall straight into an even worse one, where things get worse instead of better despite seeming to have just found a way out.
equivalent_en: out of the frying pan, into the fire
distractor_literal_en: the tiger's den and the wolf's lair
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: between a rock and a hard place

explanation_zh: 装腔作势，自以为重要。
meaning_en: It describes someone acting overly important and superior, putting on airs as if they are more significant, powerful, or impressive than they really are.

explanation_zh: 自己能力不足，却怪工具或环境不好。
meaning_en: It describes someone who lacks the skill to do something well but shifts the blame onto bad tools, poor conditions, or an unfavorable environment instead of recognizing their own shortcomings.
equivalent_en: a bad workman blames his tools

explanation_zh: 公众往往能判断事情真相。
meaning_en: This phrase means that ordinary people are usually perceptive enough to see through confusion, rumors, or deception and judge what is really happening.
equivalent_en: the public can see through the deception
distractor_literal_en: the people’s eyes are bright as snow

explanation_zh: 鲁莽挑衅远比自己强大的人。
meaning_en: It means recklessly provoking someone powerful, especially by foolishly challenging or antagonizing a person or force far stronger than oneself.

explanation_zh: 受骗或跌倒后能增长见识。
meaning_en: The phrase means that being deceived or tricked can become a hard lesson, helping someone gain experience, grow wiser, and avoid making the same mistake again.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: when in Rome, do as the Romans do

explanation_zh: 向某人投去调情、暧昧的眼神。
meaning_en: It means giving someone flirtatious looks, often by casting suggestive or affectionate glances to signal romantic interest, attraction, or playful ambiguity.

explanation_zh: 两个强势人物难以共处或共同掌权。
meaning_en: It means that two strong leaders cannot share the same domain, because dominant or powerful figures usually clash when they try to coexist, cooperate, or hold authority in the same space.
equivalent_en: two dominant leaders cannot share power
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: too many cooks spoil the broth

explanation_zh: 已经一无所有或处于低谷的人，不再害怕进一步打击。
meaning_en: It describes someone who has already lost everything or hit rock bottom, so they no longer fear additional setbacks, punishment, or further decline because they feel there is nothing left to lose.
distractor_literal_en: a dead pig is not afraid of boiling water
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: when the going gets tough, the tough get going

explanation_zh: 说话前要谨慎思考，因为言语可能带来严重后果。
meaning_en: It means you should think carefully before speaking, because careless words can lead to serious consequences that may be difficult to handle afterward.
distractor_literal_en: a lawyer cannot perform a one-man show

explanation_zh: 伟大的成就往往从微小开端发展而来。
meaning_en: It means that big achievements start from small beginnings, emphasizing that great results often grow gradually from tiny first steps or seemingly insignificant origins.
equivalent_en: great oaks from little acorns grow
distractor_literal_en: a tree that fills both arms is born from a hair tip
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: mighty oaks are often struck by lightning
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: Rome was not built in a day

term_zh: 船主的繁荣掌握在风的手里
explanation_zh: 成功受制于外部力量，自己难以完全掌控。
meaning_en: It means that a person’s success or prosperity ultimately depends on external forces and changing circumstances beyond their own control, no matter how much effort or planning they put in.
equivalent_en: at the mercy of forces beyond one's control
distractor_literal_en: the ship owner’s prosperity is in the wind’s hand
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: a rising tide lifts all boats

explanation_zh: 反复冒同样的风险，迟早会出事。
meaning_en: Repeatedly exposing yourself to the same danger or risky situation will eventually catch up with you and lead to trouble, even if nothing goes wrong at first.
equivalent_en: the old pitcher went to the well once too often
distractor_literal_en: the clay jar breaks at the well mouth
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: a burnt child dreads the fire

explanation_zh: 自己能力不足，却怪工具或条件不好。
meaning_en: It describes people who lack the necessary skill or ability but blame their tools, conditions, or circumstances instead of recognizing their own shortcomings.
equivalent_en: a bad workman blames his tools
distractor_literal_en: poor writing blames the bald brush
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: the pen is mightier than the sword
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: use the right tool for the job

explanation_zh: 伤害别人后，又进一步羞辱或责怪对方。
meaning_en: It describes hurting someone and then blaming, mocking, or shaming them for being hurt, thereby making an already painful or unfair situation even worse.
equivalent_en: hurt someone, then blame them for being hurt
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: sticks and stones may break my bones

explanation_zh: 因愤怒、受惊或戒备而突然激动起来。
meaning_en: It describes someone suddenly becoming angry, startled, or tense, as if immediately bristling in reaction to fear, irritation, or a sense of danger.

explanation_zh: 曾经受过伤害的人，在类似情境中会更加谨慎。
meaning_en: Once hurt, people become more cautious, especially when facing situations that resemble the painful experience that harmed them before.
equivalent_en: a burnt child dreads the fire

explanation_zh: 原本保密的事情已经泄露出去。
meaning_en: It means that information that was supposed to remain confidential has leaked out, so a secret has become known to others.
equivalent_en: the cat is out of the bag
distractor_literal_en: the sound of wind has leaked out

explanation_zh: 没有管束者在场时，人们就容易放纵胡闹。
meaning_en: People tend to misbehave, act recklessly, or cause trouble when no authority figure is present to supervise or restrain them.
equivalent_en: when the cat's away, the mice will play
distractor_literal_en: the cat is away and the mouse squeaks
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: while the boss is away, the team works harder

explanation_zh: 难以处理、难以解决的问题或人。
meaning_en: It refers to a difficult problem or person that is hard to deal with and resists simple, quick, or straightforward solutions.

explanation_zh: 一条路不通，还会有别的机会。
meaning_en: It means that when one path or plan fails, another opportunity may still appear elsewhere, so a setback does not mean all possibilities are gone.
equivalent_en: when one door shuts, another opens
distractor_literal_en: if the east is not bright, the west is bright
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: the grass is always greener on the other side

explanation_zh: 短期困难可能带来长期好结果。
meaning_en: Short-term setbacks can bring long-term benefits, meaning temporary difficulties or unpleasant experiences may eventually lead to positive outcomes, growth, or better opportunities over time.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: make hay while the sun shines

explanation_zh: 说话甜，但带有讨好或不真诚的意味。
meaning_en: It describes speaking in an overly sweet or flattering way, often with an insincere tone, to please someone or win their favor in order to get what one wants.

explanation_zh: 不小心把秘密或真相说了出来。
meaning_en: It refers to accidentally blurting out the truth or revealing a secret unintentionally, often because someone speaks too quickly or carelessly before realizing what they have exposed.

explanation_zh: 自己也有同样问题，却批评别人。
meaning_en: It describes criticizing or mocking someone else for a fault or mistake while having the same kind of problem oneself, making the criticism hypocritical.
equivalent_en: the pot calls the kettle black
distractor_literal_en: fifty steps laugh at a hundred steps

explanation_zh: 本想占便宜，结果反而遭受更大损失。
meaning_en: It describes trying to gain an unfair advantage or profit through overreaching, but failing and ending up suffering a greater loss instead.
equivalent_en: try to gain an unfair advantage and end up suffering a bigger loss
distractor_literal_en: try to steal a chicken and end up losing a handful of rice
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: bit off more than you can chew

explanation_zh: 局势混乱时，更容易趁机谋取私利。
meaning_en: It means taking advantage of chaos for personal gain, especially when a confusing or unstable situation makes it easier to act selfishly without being noticed.
distractor_literal_en: muddy water is good for catching fish
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: every cloud has a silver lining

term_zh: 山中无老虎，猴子称大王
explanation_zh: 强者不在时，较弱者也能占据主导。
meaning_en: It means that a weaker person can take charge or dominate a situation when stronger rivals or more capable competitors are absent.
equivalent_en: weaker players dominate when stronger rivals are absent
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: the early bird catches the worm

explanation_zh: 这件事只限你我知道，必须保密。
meaning_en: It means keeping something strictly between us, with the understanding that only the two people involved know about it and that it must remain completely confidential.
distractor_literal_en: heaven knows, earth knows, you know, I know

explanation_zh: 有苦说不出，只能默默忍受。
meaning_en: It describes a situation of suffering in silence without being able to explain, where someone has grievances or pain but cannot voice them and must quietly endure.

explanation_zh: 不要为了节省小成本而造成巨大损失。
meaning_en: It means not trying to save a tiny cost or small effort when doing so could lead to a much bigger loss or serious damage overall.
distractor_literal_en: lose a finger to save the palm
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: don't throw good money after bad

explanation_zh: 事情要失败、落空，最终不会发生。
meaning_en: It means that something is likely to fail, fall through, or come to nothing, so it is not going to happen after all.

explanation_zh: 在整体水平较弱的环境中，普通人也可能显得突出。
meaning_en: It means that a mediocre person can appear superior or impressive when surrounded by people who are even less capable, because the overall standard of the group is weak.
equivalent_en: in the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king
distractor_literal_en: a one-eyed king in a blind country

explanation_zh: 口头上喜欢，真正面对时却退缩。
meaning_en: It describes someone who claims to be enthusiastic about something in theory, but when faced with the real thing, backs away or reveals they were never truly committed.
equivalent_en: claim to love something but avoid the real thing

explanation_zh: 聪明人会准备多个退路或备选方案。
meaning_en: A clever person keeps multiple backup plans, meaning someone prudent prepares several fallback options or escape routes so they are not trapped if one path fails.
equivalent_en: it is a poor mouse that has only one hole
distractor_literal_en: a crafty rabbit has three burrows
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: the early bird catches the worm

explanation_zh: 先掌握基础，再做更难的事情。
meaning_en: It means you should master the basics first before attempting harder tasks, building skills step by step instead of rushing into something more advanced too early.
equivalent_en: don't run before you can walk
distractor_literal_en: learn to climb before learning to walk
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: Rome wasn't built in a day
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: slow and steady wins the race

explanation_zh: 谐音梗，用于嘲讽某人胆小、懦弱、很 low。
meaning_en: This pun is used to mock someone as cowardly or pathetic, implying that they are timid, spineless, or embarrassingly low in character or behavior.

explanation_zh: 房贷、车贷和下一代，形容普通人沉重的生活经济压力。
meaning_en: “The three burdens of working-class life” refers to the heavy financial pressures ordinary people face from a mortgage, a car loan, and the cost of raising the next generation.
equivalent_en: mortgage, car loan, and raising a child

explanation_zh: ACG 圈吐槽语，表面调侃贫乳，实际讽刺对方没资格发言。
meaning_en: This ACG meme phrase mockingly tells someone to be quiet by joking about a small chest, but its real meaning is dismissing someone as unqualified to speak.

explanation_zh: 日语“おっぱい”的音译，指胸部，常见于 ACG 圈。
meaning_en: “Opai” is Japanese-derived slang used especially in ACG fandom to refer to breasts, often appearing in anime, manga, and gaming discussions with a playful or fan-service-related tone.

term_zh: 只要可爱就算是男孩子也没关系
explanation_zh: 只要足够可爱，性别就变得不重要。
meaning_en: It means that if someone is cute enough, gender matters less, so attractiveness or charm can make their gender feel unimportant in how people react to them.
equivalent_en: if it’s cute, gender doesn’t matter
distractor_literal_en: as long as it is cute, boys do not matter

explanation_zh: 调侃账号可能被封禁，期待对方换新号再出现。
meaning_en: A joking remark implying that someone’s current account may be banned soon, but they are expected to reappear under a new account or username afterward.
equivalent_en: see you on your next alt
distractor_literal_en: see you at the next ID
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: see you after your account gets banned
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: see you on the other side

explanation_zh: 调皮捣蛋后自得其乐。
meaning_en: It means playfully messing around or causing a little harmless trouble, then feeling pleased and amused by one's own mischievous behavior.

explanation_zh: 调侃射击游戏玩家枪法差，子弹完美避开目标。
meaning_en: A humorous label for someone with terrible aim in shooting games, joking that their shots trace the outline of an opponent while somehow missing the target completely.

explanation_zh: 游戏中贴着掩体反复走位以躲避攻击。
meaning_en: “Qin Wang footwork” refers to juking around cover to dodge attacks in a game, repeatedly moving close to obstacles or terrain so opponents have trouble landing hits.

explanation_zh: 游戏中抢先拿到最后一击，夺取击杀奖励。
meaning_en: “Taking the final hit that someone else set up” means swooping in during a game to land the last blow on an enemy another player mostly defeated, thereby claiming the kill reward or credit.

explanation_zh: 游戏中用非官方、迷信式方法影响随机结果。
meaning_en: A superstition around RNG or drops, referring to players using unofficial or ritual-like methods in games to supposedly influence random outcomes such as loot drops, pulls, or other chance-based results.

explanation_zh: 视频上滚动出现的实时评论，形成群体观看体验。
meaning_en: Scrolling real-time comments over a video are viewer messages that move across the screen during playback, creating a shared watching experience where reactions, jokes, and commentary appear alongside the content as it is being viewed.

explanation_zh: 原指 ACG 爱好者团结，后常用于讽刺圈内争端。
meaning_en: It is an ironic claim that all anime fans are one family, often used to mock the ideal of fan unity when anime or ACG communities are actually arguing or divided.
equivalent_en: weebs are one big happy family
distractor_literal_en: all comic friends under heaven are one family

explanation_zh: 指被大量美化 MOD 改造后的《上古卷轴》游戏。
meaning_en: It refers to a heavily modded version of The Elder Scrolls in which visual enhancement mods make the game, especially its female characters, look much more beautified and stylized.

explanation_zh: 对《上古卷轴》系列的戏称。
meaning_en: Old Man Scrollbar" is a joke nickname for The Elder Scrolls series, playing on a humorous literal-sounding reinterpretation of its Chinese title rather than referring to an actual old man or scrollbar.
equivalent_en: joke nickname for The Elder Scrolls

explanation_zh: 表示非常可爱，或可爱到让人被打动。
meaning_en: It describes someone or something as extremely cute or overwhelmingly adorable, to the point that their charm feels instantly heart-melting and emotionally disarming.

explanation_zh: 爱称，指可爱、善良、纯真的人物。
meaning_en: It is an affectionate term for a sweet, pure, lovable person, often used to describe someone seen as cute, kind-hearted, innocent, and emotionally comforting.

explanation_zh: 网络中亲切称呼温柔漂亮的年轻女性。
meaning_en: “Xiaojiejie” is a friendly online term used to affectionately refer to a gentle, pretty young woman, often with a warm or admiring tone.

explanation_zh: 小声在背后议论别人，通常带八卦或负面意味。
meaning_en: It refers to quietly gossiping about someone behind their back, often with a nosy, critical, or negative tone rather than speaking openly to the person involved.

explanation_zh: 反讽某事表现很差、很弱、很烂，让人无语。
meaning_en: It is used sarcastically to describe something as painfully bad, weak, or disappointing, implying that its poor performance leaves people speechless rather than genuinely moved.

explanation_zh: 对魔性音视频或内容上瘾，反复观看停不下来。
meaning_en: It means becoming addicted to viral or catchy content, especially a strangely compelling video, song, or post that someone keeps watching or replaying because they cannot stop.

explanation_zh: 形容情侣角色之间出现甜蜜互动、秀恩爱剧情。
meaning_en: It refers to sweet romantic moments between a shipped couple, especially scenes where two characters share affectionate interactions, flirtation, or relationship-coded behavior that fans enjoy as evidence of their chemistry.

explanation_zh: 长时间等待后终于看到作品更新、完结或实现。
meaning_en: It means finally seeing something happen after a long wait, especially when an update, ending, release, or long-promised event arrives after people had waited so long they almost stopped expecting it.
distractor_literal_en: during the years one is alive

explanation_zh: 对图像或视频敏感区域进行模糊、马赛克处理。
meaning_en: It means censoring or blurring part of an image or video, typically by applying mosaic, pixelation, or blur to sensitive areas so the original visual details cannot be clearly seen.
equivalent_en: censor or pixelate the sensitive area

explanation_zh: 指道德、节操或行为的最低底线，常用于贬义。
meaning_en: It refers to a new moral or behavioral low, used negatively to describe someone’s actions, standards, or sense of decency falling beneath the minimum baseline people would normally expect.

explanation_zh: 形容女性优雅、平稳、几乎无上下波动的走路方式。
meaning_en: It describes a smooth and elegant gliding walk, especially by women, where the steps look graceful, steady, and almost free of any visible up-and-down movement.

explanation_zh: 事业、爱情、人生等方面都令人羡慕的成功者。
meaning_en: A “winner in life” describes someone who appears enviably successful across major areas of life, especially career, relationships, and personal happiness.

explanation_zh: 表示前一句是故意曲解、玩笑或“大误/大污”式吐槽。
meaning_en: Used after a statement to signal that it was a joke, deliberate misreading, or intentionally misleading twist rather than something meant to be taken seriously.
equivalent_en: just kidding, I was deliberately misreading it

explanation_zh: ACGN 中男主角的主要情感对象或核心女主。
meaning_en: The term refers to the main canon love interest in an ACGN story, typically the central heroine or primary romantic partner intended to be paired with the male protagonist.

explanation_zh: 作品突破小圈层，引起广泛社会关注。
meaning_en: It describes a work that breaks out beyond its original niche audience and becomes a broad cultural hit, attracting widespread public attention and discussion across society.

explanation_zh: 看起来强大、神秘、超出常规理解的技术或产品。
meaning_en: It refers to seemingly magical or advanced technology or products that appear powerful, mysterious, and beyond ordinary understanding, often suggesting capabilities that feel futuristic or difficult to explain.

explanation_zh: 女方主动追求男方，甚至用财物补贴对方。
meaning_en: It means actively pursuing someone romantically while also offering support, attention, or even material help, often implying that one person is putting in extra effort to win the other’s affection.
equivalent_en: a woman pursues a man and supports him financially

explanation_zh: 出身或父母普通甚至糟糕，却出现优秀子女。
meaning_en: It describes a capable, admirable child or descendant who emerges despite coming from unimpressive, disadvantaged, or flawed parents or family background, meaning good offspring from poor or flawed stock.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: a chip off the old block

explanation_zh: 女性强势、男性柔弱或依赖的恋爱关系动态。
meaning_en: A relationship dynamic where the woman takes a more dominant, assertive role while the male partner is portrayed as softer, gentler, more dependent, or emotionally yielding.

explanation_zh: 夸张表示被吓到、恶心到或强烈震惊。
meaning_en: It means being so extremely scared or shocked by something that the reaction is exaggerated as losing control, often used humorously for fear, disgust, or intense surprise.

explanation_zh: 网络用语，表示大笑，也可带嘲讽意味。
meaning_en: This term is used online to represent laughter, often like “LOL,” and can also carry a teasing or sarcastic tone when someone is laughing at a situation or mocking another person.

explanation_zh: 自信判断被现实反向证明，令人尴尬。
meaning_en: It describes the embarrassing moment when someone makes a confident claim or judgment, only for reality to prove it wrong and expose their mistake.

explanation_zh: 情侣秀恩爱让单身者感到被刺激或自嘲。
meaning_en: Couple PDA making singles feel attacked" describes couples openly showing affection in a way that makes single people feel teased, excluded, or jokingly victimized by the display.
equivalent_en: couple PDA making singles feel attacked

explanation_zh: 故意煽动舆论、引导跟风或挑起争端。
meaning_en: It means deliberately stirring up public opinion or conflict online by pushing a narrative, encouraging others to follow along, or provoking arguments within a discussion.
equivalent_en: push a narrative to stir up conflict

explanation_zh: 发布诱导性内容，引人上钩、争论或围观。
meaning_en: Posting bait to provoke reactions online means sharing deliberately provocative or leading content to lure people into arguing, responding emotionally, or gathering to watch the resulting online drama.
equivalent_en: posting bait to provoke reactions online

explanation_zh: 不顾风险做危险或惹祸的事。
meaning_en: It means doing reckless things that invite trouble, especially by ignoring obvious risks or provoking consequences through dangerous, foolish, or needlessly troublesome behavior.

explanation_zh: 源自 nice 音译，表示“不错、很棒”，也带“撕”的双关趣味。
meaning_en: It means something is “nice” or impressive, using a playful Chinese transliteration of the English word “nice” that also carries a punning hint of “tearing” for humorous effect.

explanation_zh: 现在不一定出色，但未来很有发展前途的人或事物。
meaning_en: It describes someone or something that may not stand out right now but is seen as having strong future potential and likely to become much more successful or valuable over time.

explanation_zh: 作曲优秀、传播广、影响大的音乐作品。
meaning_en: A “god-tier song” is a widely loved and highly impressive piece of music, admired for its strong composition, broad popularity, and notable cultural impact.

term_zh: 你是猴子请来的救兵吗
explanation_zh: 调侃对方搞笑、不靠谱或像来捣乱的帮手。
meaning_en: It jokingly teases someone as a ridiculous, unreliable helper whose attempts to assist seem more like causing trouble than actually solving the problem.
equivalent_en: are you here to help or to make things worse
distractor_literal_en: are you reinforcements sent by the monkey

explanation_zh: 严肃话题后突然转折，用广告式口号制造幽默。
meaning_en: It refers to an abrupt meme punchline that derails the topic, suddenly shifting from a serious discussion into a slogan-like advertising catchphrase for humorous contrast.
distractor_literal_en: which excavator school is the strongest

explanation_zh: 平等照顾各方，不偏袒某一方；也常带调侃意味。
meaning_en: It means giving everyone equal attention or favor, treating all sides fairly without showing favoritism, often with a joking tone about spreading care, praise, benefits, or affection evenly among multiple people or groups.

explanation_zh: 自嘲控制不住购物欲，尤其是网购时疯狂买买买。
meaning_en: It humorously describes compulsive online shopping, especially when someone cannot resist buying things online and jokingly blames themselves for repeatedly giving in to shopping urges.

explanation_zh: 鼓励或推荐某人应获得某物或体验。
meaning_en: It is used to encourage or recommend that someone should have or experience something worthwhile, meaning they genuinely deserve something good and should feel entitled to enjoy it.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: you should have this good thing

explanation_zh: 暂时不要下结论，先观察事情发展。
meaning_en: It means to avoid jumping to conclusions and wait and see how things develop before deciding what is really happening or how to respond.
equivalent_en: wait and see how it plays out
distractor_literal_en: let the bullet fly for a while

explanation_zh: 用自然纪录片式台词调侃恋爱、暧昧或春心萌动。
meaning_en: This phrase jokingly frames romance, flirting, or romantic excitement as if a nature documentary narrator were announcing that the season for courtship and mating has arrived.
equivalent_en: the mating season is upon us
distractor_literal_en: the season for crossbreeding is here again

explanation_zh: 装傻、回避话题或假装没听见。
meaning_en: It means pretending not to notice something, acting unaware, or dodging the topic by behaving as if you are casually looking around instead of responding directly.
equivalent_en: play dumb and dodge the topic
distractor_literal_en: pretend to look at the scenery everywhere

term_zh: 正义也许会迟到但绝不会缺席
explanation_zh: 相信正义最终会实现，即使来得很晚。
meaning_en: It expresses the belief that justice will arrive eventually, even if delayed, emphasizing faith that wrongs will ultimately be corrected no matter how long the process takes.
equivalent_en: justice delayed is not justice denied
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: with liberty and justice for all
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: the wheels of justice grind slowly

term_zh: 只要推力大板砖也能飞上天
explanation_zh: 足够强的动力可以弥补设计或性能缺陷。
meaning_en: It means that with enough power or force, even something badly designed or inefficient can still work, emphasizing that raw power can compensate for poor design.
equivalent_en: with enough power, even bad design can work
distractor_literal_en: a brick literally flying through the sky
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: throwing a brick to attract jade

explanation_zh: 回击水帖刷经验的人，意为“经验拿好赶紧滚”。
meaning_en: A dismissive reply to someone posting low-effort content just to gain forum experience points, meaning they should take their XP reward and leave immediately.
equivalent_en: take your XP and get out
distractor_literal_en: take the experience and roll away
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: stop posting meaningless content for points

explanation_zh: 人生已经很艰难，不要再揭穿难堪真相。
meaning_en: It means that life is already hard enough, so one should avoid exposing painful or embarrassing truths that would make someone feel even worse.
equivalent_en: life is hard enough; don't expose the painful truth
distractor_literal_en: life is hard, do not dismantle it

explanation_zh: 劝人要善良、留余地、不要太过分。
meaning_en: It means that people should be kind and decent to others, acting with generosity, restraint, and a sense of fairness instead of being harsh, excessive, or needlessly unforgiving.

explanation_zh: 表达悔改、想变好，也可用于自嘲。
meaning_en: It expresses a desire to repent, improve oneself, or turn over a new leaf, often used sincerely but also self-deprecatingly when someone jokes about wanting to be a better person.
distractor_literal_en: I want to do a good person
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: May the Force be with me

explanation_zh: 调侃某人行为大胆、出格、令人意外。
meaning_en: A teasing remark directed at someone whose behavior is surprisingly bold, outrageous, or over-the-top, often implying playful shock rather than serious criticism.

explanation_zh: 某事荒谬到让死去的人都“气活了”。
meaning_en: Used when something is so absurd, offensive, or outrageous that even a dead person would be furious enough to rise from the grave in protest.
equivalent_en: he would be rolling in his grave
distractor_literal_en: the coffin plank is too weak

term_zh: 我和我的小伙伴们都惊呆了
explanation_zh: 表达极度震惊、难以置信。
meaning_en: It means being extremely shocked and speechless, often used when someone encounters something so surprising or unbelievable that they and everyone around them are left stunned.
distractor_literal_en: my little buddies and I turned silly

term_zh: 我的内心几乎是崩溃的
explanation_zh: 表达受到打击后的崩溃、无奈和震惊。
meaning_en: It describes someone feeling mentally overwhelmed or near breakdown after being hit by bad news, pressure, or an unexpected setback, often mixing shock, helplessness, and emotional collapse.
equivalent_en: I'm on the verge of a mental breakdown

explanation_zh: 表示早已看透真相，不再惊讶。
meaning_en: It means having seen through everything all along, recognizing the truth from the beginning and therefore no longer feeling surprised by what others are only just discovering.
equivalent_en: I saw through it all along
distractor_literal_en: however, I looked through everything long ago

explanation_zh: 用幽默方式表达受到打击后的心理创伤程度。
meaning_en: A humorous way to describe or exaggerate how emotionally damaged, shocked, or hurt someone feels after an upsetting, embarrassing, or discouraging experience.
distractor_literal_en: calculate the area of psychological shadow

explanation_zh: 高兴或讽刺地表示得到某物、遭遇某事。
meaning_en: Used sincerely or sarcastically, it jokingly says that someone has just obtained something, often framing a new possession, outcome, or even an unwanted experience as if it were a cheerful acquisition.

explanation_zh: 表示非常努力，有时带讽刺意味。
meaning_en: It describes someone as having tried extremely hard or gone to great lengths, often with admiration but sometimes used sarcastically to suggest the effort was excessive, awkward, or not entirely worthwhile.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: pull yourself up by your bootstraps

explanation_zh: 调侃言行、穿着过于奔放、张扬或“骚气”。
meaning_en: Used to jokingly tease someone whose behavior, outfit, or overall style seems overly flashy, attention-seeking, bold, or suggestive in a deliberately exaggerated way.

explanation_zh: 形容事物厉害、刚猛、酷炫或难度很高。
meaning_en: This term describes something as intense, cool, tough, or highly difficult, often emphasizing that it feels powerful, uncompromising, impressive, or challenging in a striking way.

term_zh: 我信你个鬼哦你个糟老头子坏得很
explanation_zh: 表达不相信对方，调侃其在糊弄或骗人。
meaning_en: It means bluntly refusing to believe someone’s nonsense, often in a joking or teasing way, because they seem to be fooling, tricking, or talking rubbish.
distractor_literal_en: I believe your ghost, you bad old man

explanation_zh: 调侃对方行为离谱、狠毒、搞笑或出人意料。
meaning_en: It jokingly calls someone evil or outrageous when their behavior seems absurdly harsh, unexpectedly funny, over-the-top, or so surprising that it feels playfully “devilish.”

explanation_zh: 嘲讽场上没有真正有能力或出色的人。
meaning_en: It mockingly means that no one present has enough real skill, strength, or ability to be a serious competitor or worthy opponent.
distractor_literal_en: not a single one can hit
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: bring a knife to a gunfight

explanation_zh: 鼓励在困难中坚持到底，不放弃任何人或希望。
meaning_en: It means refusing to abandon anyone or give up hope, encouraging people to persist through hardship and stand by others until the end.
equivalent_en: leave no one behind and never give up
distractor_literal_en: no throwing away, no giving up
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: all for one and one for all

explanation_zh: 用于转移话题、互动或玩梗式征求看法。
meaning_en: It is a meme-like way of asking someone for their take, often used playfully to invite an opinion, shift the topic, or create a joking moment of interaction.
distractor_literal_en: Yuanfang, how do you see it

explanation_zh: 表示某句话或场景包含大量隐含信息，值得脑补。
meaning_en: The phrase means that a statement or scene seems packed with implied details, suggesting there is a lot of hidden meaning to unpack and inviting people to read between the lines.
equivalent_en: there’s a lot to unpack here

explanation_zh: 面向女性玩家、以男性角色和恋爱体验为卖点的游戏。
meaning_en: A romance game targeted mainly at female players, typically centered on interacting with attractive male characters and experiencing story-driven romantic relationships as the core appeal.

explanation_zh: 网络流行的重复摆动身体的舞蹈形式。
meaning_en: A viral dance with repetitive body shaking, often associated with internet videos where people rhythmically sway, bounce, or shake their bodies in a simple, exaggerated, and easily imitated style.

term_zh: 质疑伍佰理解伍佰成为一千
explanation_zh: 从调侃歌手不唱，到理解并经历类似粉丝大合唱场面的梗。
meaning_en: It means progressing from questioning or mocking someone’s behavior to finally understanding their situation through experience, and eventually becoming the same kind of person yourself.
equivalent_en: I judged him, then I got it, then I became him
distractor_literal_en: question Wu Bai, understand Wu Bai, become one thousand
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: went from mocking it to fully understanding it

explanation_zh: 亚洲人常见的深蹲姿势，双脚完全着地。
meaning_en: The term refers to the deep squat often associated with Asian posture habits, where a person squats low with both feet flat on the ground, seen as a familiar resting or everyday posture.

explanation_zh: 作品或计划中途被迫停播、缩减或提前结束。
meaning_en: It describes a series, creative work, or planned project being forced to stop, shrink, or end ahead of schedule, effectively being cut short prematurely before its intended completion.

explanation_zh: 单集很短、差不多泡面时间就能看完的动画。
meaning_en: It refers to very short anime episodes lasting only a few minutes, roughly the time it takes to prepare instant noodles, making them quick and easy to watch in one sitting.

explanation_zh: 表达想冷静一下，也可借“静静”作为人名玩梗。
meaning_en: It means someone is frustrated or overwhelmed and wants a quiet moment to calm down, often phrased as if they simply want to be alone with “Jingjing” as a playful name-based joke.

explanation_zh: 自嘲自己能力弱、水平差，也可用于调侃。
meaning_en: It is a self-deprecating way to admit that one is bad at something, lacks skill, or performed poorly, often said jokingly after making mistakes or failing at a task.

term_zh: 我今天吃药的时候看到一个新闻
explanation_zh: 用“吃药”埋伏笔，测试对方是否关心自己。
meaning_en: This phrase means burying the real concern inside a casual statement, casually mentioning something like taking medicine to see whether the other person notices, asks about it, and shows genuine concern.
equivalent_en: mentioning medicine as bait to see if they care
distractor_literal_en: I saw news while taking medicine today

term_zh: 我给你一次重新组织语言的机会
explanation_zh: 对对方说法不满，半开玩笑地要求其重新表述。
meaning_en: This phrase is a half-joking way to show dissatisfaction with what someone just said, giving them a chance to rephrase after saying something wrong or inappropriate.
equivalent_en: I'll give you a chance to rephrase that
distractor_literal_en: I give you one chance to reorganize language

term_zh: 请允许我做一个悲伤的表情
explanation_zh: 表面表示同情，实际带嬉笑、嘲讽或自黑意味。
meaning_en: It means offering exaggerated or performative sympathy while clearly trying not to laugh, often with a teasing, mocking, or self-deprecating tone rather than genuine sadness.
distractor_literal_en: let me put on a sad face

explanation_zh: 面对无能为力的情况时表达无奈、绝望和自嘲。
meaning_en: “I am helpless and desperate too” is used to express resignation, despair, and self-mocking frustration when facing a situation where nothing can really be done.
equivalent_en: What can I do? I feel helpless and desperate too.
distractor_literal_en: how should I do, I am very hopeless too

explanation_zh: 对荒谬、过分或不可接受的事情表示强烈吐槽。
meaning_en: Used to strongly vent disbelief or outrage at something absurd, excessive, or unacceptable, as if asking how any reasonable person could possibly do such a thing.
equivalent_en: what kind of monster does this
distractor_literal_en: is this something a human does

term_zh: 人与人之间最基本的信任在哪里
explanation_zh: 对缺乏信任或被欺骗的情况表示无奈和调侃。
meaning_en: A joking complaint about broken trust, used to express helplessness or mock frustration when someone feels trust is missing, has been violated, or they have been tricked.
distractor_literal_en: where do people keep their basic trust

explanation_zh: 用来打断或调侃某人正在做的无意义、荒谬行为。
meaning_en: It jokingly tells someone to stop messing around with something pointless or absurd and go home, as if their mother is calling them back for dinner.
distractor_literal_en: your mom cooked dinner at home

explanation_zh: 对复杂、新奇或难以理解的行为表示惊讶和吐槽。
meaning_en: It is a teasing remark aimed at people doing something weird, overly elaborate, novel, or hard to understand, expressing amused surprise and mild mockery at behavior that feels unnecessarily complicated or strange.
equivalent_en: you city folks sure are wild
distractor_literal_en: you city people really know how to play
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: that is too strange for me to understand

explanation_zh: 用“你厉害你来做”反驳批评者。
meaning_en: Used to push back against criticism by saying that if someone believes they can do better, they should step up and do it themselves instead of just judging from the sidelines.
equivalent_en: if you're so good, do it yourself
distractor_literal_en: if you can, go up there

explanation_zh: 调侃某人知道太多内幕或秘密，可能“危险”。
meaning_en: Used jokingly to suggest that someone has learned too many secrets, inside details, or sensitive information, playfully implying that knowing so much could put them in trouble.

explanation_zh: 用知乎式提问格式征集某种经历的感受。
meaning_en: It is a Zhihu-style question format used to ask people what it feels like to experience a particular situation, event, identity, or condition.
distractor_literal_en: what kind of experience is it

explanation_zh: 表示某事违背常识、令人难以置信。
meaning_en: This phrase is used to say that something makes no sense, defies logic, or feels so unbelievable that it seems to go against common sense.

explanation_zh: 形容在危险、违规或后果不佳的边界上反复挑衅。
meaning_en: “Testing the boundary of trouble or danger” describes repeatedly pushing close to a risky, forbidden, or problematic line, provoking consequences while not yet fully crossing into obvious trouble.
distractor_literal_en: testing at the edge of XX

explanation_zh: 形容问题非常简单，答案显而易见。
meaning_en: This phrase refers to an extremely easy question where the answer is obvious, as if it were practically giving points away to anyone who sees it.

explanation_zh: 调侃有钱人做事随心所欲、不受限制。
meaning_en: This phrase jokingly suggests that rich people can do whatever they want, acting freely and impulsively because their money lets them ignore normal limits or consequences.
equivalent_en: money lets you do whatever you want

explanation_zh: 谐音骂人梗，源自“你智障吗？不，我犯贱”。
meaning_en: A pun-based self-mocking insult that twists a hostile question about being stupid into a deliberately absurd reply, implying the speaker is not merely foolish but knowingly acting in a ridiculous or self-degrading way.
equivalent_en: are you dumb? no, I’m just asking for it
distractor_literal_en: do you make staffs? no, I sell swords
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: are you stupid? no, I am being cheap

explanation_zh: 邀请别人感受、评价某个观点、图片或场景。
meaning_en: Used to invite others to take in a viewpoint, image, scene, or situation for themselves and judge or react to it based on their own impression.
equivalent_en: take a look and judge for yourselves
distractor_literal_en: you all feel it a bit

term_zh: 有件事说出来你可能不信
explanation_zh: 引出荒诞、离谱或难以置信的事情。
meaning_en: This phrase is used to preface a story, claim, or situation that sounds so unbelievable, absurd, or outrageous that the listener may doubt it even though it is being presented as true.
distractor_literal_en: I have an object you might not believe in

explanation_zh: 面对震惊或难以理解的事情时一脸茫然。
meaning_en: It describes someone looking completely confused and stunned when faced with something shocking, unexpected, or too hard to understand, with a blank expression that shows they have no idea what is happening.

term_zh: 虐妻一时爽追妻火葬场
explanation_zh: 男主先伤害女主，后来后悔并艰难挽回。
meaning_en: A romance trope where the male lead mistreats or hurts the heroine at first, then deeply regrets it and suffers through a difficult, often humiliating pursuit to win her back.
distractor_literal_en: abusing wife feels good for a while, chasing wife is a crematorium
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: regret after hurting the romantic partner

explanation_zh: 通过经营、建设、积累资源逐渐发展的小说类型。
meaning_en: A genre of slow-building fiction centered on gradual development through management, construction, and resource accumulation, where progress comes from steady growth rather than sudden dramatic breakthroughs.

explanation_zh: 调侃明明心虚却还用大声掩饰。
meaning_en: This phrase teases someone who raises their voice to cover up feeling guilty or insecure, implying that their loudness is an obvious attempt to hide a lack of confidence.
equivalent_en: getting loud to cover your guilt

explanation_zh: 嘲讽某人过分、夸张、不切实际或太离谱。
meaning_en: It is used to mock someone for being absurdly over the top, implying that their behavior, demands, or claims are so exaggerated and unrealistic that they are almost ridiculous.
equivalent_en: why not ask for the moon while you’re at it?
distractor_literal_en: why don’t you fly up to the sky

explanation_zh: 吐槽对方没有自知之明，明知却装糊涂。
meaning_en: Used to call someone out for lacking self-awareness, especially when they should clearly understand their own flaws, limits, or situation but act ignorant or pretend not to know.
distractor_literal_en: don’t you have a number B in your heart
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: you should know better than that

explanation_zh: 因断句、标点或文字误解造成的搞笑误会。
meaning_en: A joke caused by ambiguous punctuation or wording, where unclear sentence breaks, marks, or phrasing lead someone to misread the text and create an unintentionally funny misunderstanding.

explanation_zh: 故意发布恶搞、重口味或深夜美食内容来“伤害”别人。
meaning_en: It means deliberately posting annoying, gross, prankish, or late-night food content to bother, disgust, or tempt other people for fun, as a way of playfully “getting back” at everyone online.
equivalent_en: posting to make everyone suffer for fun

term_zh: 彪悍的人生不需要解释
explanation_zh: 用于调侃特别另类、自信或难以理解的行为。
meaning_en: A bold and outrageous life needs no explanation, used jokingly to describe behavior that is extremely unconventional, overconfident, or hard for others to understand but carried out with unapologetic confidence.
equivalent_en: bold, outrageous behavior needs no explanation
distractor_literal_en: a burly life needs no footnotes

explanation_zh: 只存在于社交平台互动中的浅层关系。
meaning_en: A friendship that exists mostly through social media likes and comments, describing a shallow connection maintained through online interactions rather than deeper real-life closeness or meaningful personal support.

explanation_zh: 调侃某种夸张姿势、骚操作或搞笑动作。
meaning_en: It refers to a funny or exaggerated pose/action meme, used to jokingly describe an over-the-top stance, awkward move, or absurdly flashy action that looks intentionally dramatic or comical.
equivalent_en: a funny over-the-top pose or action
distractor_literal_en: a crow sitting on an airplane

explanation_zh: 表示对内容非常满意、看着很舒服。
meaning_en: The phrase describes content that feels satisfying to watch or read, especially because it is pleasing, well-matched to expectations, or gives the viewer or reader a comfortable sense of enjoyment.
equivalent_en: this content is very satisfying to watch or read

explanation_zh: 表示对方惹上麻烦了。
meaning_en: It is used to tell someone that they have gotten themselves into trouble and now have to face the consequences of what they did.
distractor_literal_en: you have spread a thing on yourself

explanation_zh: 用夸张语气表达不满、炫耀或调侃。
meaning_en: Used in an exaggerated, teasing tone to jokingly ask whether a situation is irritating or unfair, often while complaining, showing off, or playfully provoking others.

explanation_zh: 指车技高超的人，也可指网络“老司机”。
meaning_en: A person described this way is seen as someone with legendary driving or racing skill, often implying exceptional control, speed, confidence, and a reputation for outperforming others behind the wheel.

explanation_zh: 表示某事太好笑，要夸张地“追责”。
meaning_en: Used jokingly to say that something was so funny it caused an exaggerated “harm,” as if the speaker might take the person responsible to court for making them laugh too hard.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: this made me laugh too much

explanation_zh: 为了生计而不得不做某事的自嘲说法。
meaning_en: It is a self-deprecating way to say someone is doing something because they need to earn money and make a living, even if the action is awkward, compromising, or not entirely voluntary.

explanation_zh: 用日语空耳调侃“愚蠢的弟弟”。
meaning_en: A playful mock-Japanese phrase used to tease someone by calling them a foolish little brother, often in a joking or exaggeratedly dramatic tone.

explanation_zh: 反讽自己被迫上班、心不甘情不愿。
meaning_en: It sarcastically claims that one is totally willing to work, while actually expressing reluctance, resignation, or the feeling of being forced to go to work despite not wanting to.
equivalent_en: Sure, I’m totally working by choice

explanation_zh: 表面疑问，实际吐槽对方很傻或言行幼稚。
meaning_en: It is a sarcastic rhetorical jab used to call someone stupid or childish, implying that their words or behavior are so foolish that the speaker is mockingly questioning their intelligence.
distractor_literal_en: you'd better not be a fool

explanation_zh: “你算什么东西”的可爱、玩笑化表达。
meaning_en: A cute, playful way to say “who do you think you are,” softening a dismissive challenge into a teasing or joking remark rather than a harsh insult.
equivalent_en: who do you think you are
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: who are you to say that

explanation_zh: 表达只要对方安好，自己就感到幸福或安心。
meaning_en: It means that as long as the other person is safe and doing well, the speaker feels happy, at peace, and as if everything in life has become brighter.
equivalent_en: as long as you're safe and well, I'm at peace
distractor_literal_en: if you are fine, it is sunny
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: every cloud has a silver lining

term_zh: 一家人最重要的是整整齐齐
explanation_zh: 讽刺一家人一起遭遇相同坏结果或共同翻车。
meaning_en: It jokingly means that everyone in the family ends up sharing the same fate, usually used sarcastically when they all suffer the same bad outcome or fail together.
equivalent_en: the whole family went down together
distractor_literal_en: the most important thing for a family is being neat and complete

explanation_zh: 调侃人们总是爽约、放鸽子。
meaning_en: This meme jokingly means that people are naturally prone to canceling plans, breaking promises, or failing to show up, so humans are basically unreliable flakes.
distractor_literal_en: the essence of humans is pigeons
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: birds of a feather flock together
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: people are bad at making plans

explanation_zh: 含蓄表达喜欢或爱慕，类似“今晚月色真美”。
meaning_en: This phrase functions as a subtle romantic confession, indirectly expressing affection or admiration through poetic imagery instead of openly saying “I like you” or “I love you.”
equivalent_en: the moon is beautiful, isn’t it
distractor_literal_en: this world is bustling with traffic
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: I have a crush on you

explanation_zh: 用小猪佩奇和“社会人”的反差制造幽默。
meaning_en: Peppa Pig is humorously treated as a “gangsta” or tough social symbol, with the joke coming from the contrast between a cute children’s cartoon character and an exaggerated streetwise image.

explanation_zh: 理直气壮地接受伴侣或配偶的经济支持。
meaning_en: It means confidently and unapologetically living off a partner’s financial support, treating that dependence as justified rather than embarrassing or shameful.
distractor_literal_en: eat soft rice the hard way
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: pull yourself up by your bootstraps

explanation_zh: 调侃某人频繁出现在某个平台，像在那里定居。
meaning_en: It jokingly asks whether someone has “bought a house” on a platform, teasing them for always being there as if they had settled in permanently.
distractor_literal_en: did you purchase an apartment through Weibo
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: are you the mayor of Foursquare

explanation_zh: 长期营造的公众形象被现实反差摧毁。
meaning_en: It describes a situation where someone’s carefully built public persona falls apart after their real behavior, flaws, or contradictions sharply conflict with the image they had long maintained.

explanation_zh: 迫不及待地等待某事发生，表示极大期待。
meaning_en: It means waiting with extreme anticipation for something to happen, conveying an eager, almost impatient readiness as if one is fully prepared and can hardly stand the delay.
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: shut up and take my money

explanation_zh: 强调自己或他人皮肤白皙，常带傲娇或夸赞意味。
meaning_en: It is a proud or playfully admiring way to say that oneself or someone else has very fair, pale skin, often with a slightly smug or affectionate tone.

explanation_zh: 极端体验下仿佛人生快速闪过眼前。
meaning_en: It describes the sensation, usually during an extreme or frightening experience, of feeling as if one’s life flashes before one’s eyes in a rapid sequence of memories.
equivalent_en: my life flashed before my eyes

explanation_zh: 被现实教训，认清社会残酷。
meaning_en: It means receiving a harsh lesson from reality, where someone is forced by difficult experiences to recognize how unforgiving, competitive, or cruel society can be.
equivalent_en: a harsh lesson from the real world

explanation_zh: 一边前进，一边珍惜当下和已有关系。
meaning_en: It means to keep moving forward in life while appreciating the present moment and valuing the relationships and things one already has.
equivalent_en: keep moving forward while cherishing what you have
distractor_literal_en: walk and cherish as you go

explanation_zh: 显眼、富丽、像会员特权一样的大红大紫大绿。
meaning_en: It refers to flashy privileged-looking colors, especially loud reds, purples, and greens that look ornate, conspicuous, and like they belong to some premium membership or VIP-only treatment.

explanation_zh: 表示祝福前程美好、走向成功。
meaning_en: It is used to wish someone a bright and successful future, expressing the hope that their path ahead will be smooth, promising, and filled with good opportunities.
equivalent_en: may you have a bright and successful future

explanation_zh: 本身不算出色，但因同行更差而显得优秀。
meaning_en: It means someone or something appears impressive not because they are truly outstanding, but because the surrounding competitors or peers are noticeably worse by comparison.
equivalent_en: looks good only because the competition is worse
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: a rising tide lifts all boats

explanation_zh: 形容切糕等东西贵到离谱，一刀下去富豪也心疼。
meaning_en: Used to describe something, often a food sold by the slice, being so outrageously expensive that even a billionaire would feel the pain and cry after one cut or purchase.
equivalent_en: so expensive even a billionaire would cry after one slice
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: you get what you pay for

explanation_zh: 最初不同意或不情愿，后来态度发生变化。
meaning_en: It means being reluctant or unwilling at first, but later changing one’s attitude and eventually accepting or going along with the situation.
equivalent_en: I was reluctant at first, but came around

explanation_zh: 对年轻、弱小或经验不足者的调侃称呼。
meaning_en: It teasingly refers to someone as a younger, weaker, or less experienced guy, often with a slightly patronizing or joking tone toward their ability, status, or maturity.

explanation_zh: 表示情况很难承受、很难熬。
meaning_en: It describes a situation, feeling, or pressure that is too hard to handle or endure, often implying that someone is struggling to bear it or get through it.

explanation_zh: 表达看到离谱内容时的困惑、反感或无语。
meaning_en: It describes the confused, disgusted, and speechless reaction someone has when seeing bizarre, absurd, or unpleasant content online, as if staring at a phone in disbelief.
distractor_literal_en: an old man looking at his phone on the subway

explanation_zh: 对“阿瓦达索命”的空耳恶搞。
meaning_en: This meme is a playful phonetic spoof of “Avada Kedavra,” treating the Harry Potter killing curse as a silly misheard phrase for humorous effect.

explanation_zh: 某个计划、游戏或任务中的一个环节或配合角色。
meaning_en: It refers to one part or role within a broader plan, game, task, or coordinated play, emphasizing that the action or person functions as a single link in a larger strategy.
equivalent_en: one part of the overall play

term_zh: 嘴上都是主义心里全是生意
explanation_zh: 表面讲主义和正义，内心只关心利益。
meaning_en: It describes someone who publicly preaches ideals, justice, or noble principles, while privately caring mainly about business interests, personal gain, or profit.
distractor_literal_en: talking business with your mouth, believing ideology in your heart

explanation_zh: 试图挽留并忽悠别人加入某计划或组织。
meaning_en: It means suspiciously stopping someone who is about to leave and trying to persuade or trick them into joining a plan, group, or scheme.
equivalent_en: a shady attempt to stop and recruit someone
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: May the Force be with you

explanation_zh: 游戏中新玩家开始学习和熟悉规则的区域。
meaning_en: The beginner area where new players start, used to describe the initial, low-pressure place or stage where someone learns the basic rules before moving on to harder challenges.

explanation_zh: 为了利益赚取不道德或有损良心的钱。
meaning_en: It refers to making unethical money for profit, especially by doing something morally questionable, exploitative, or conscience-damaging simply because it brings financial benefit.

explanation_zh: 通过制造羞耻感来进行心理惩罚、调侃或控制。
meaning_en: This refers to using embarrassment deliberately as part of teasing, psychological punishment, or control, making someone feel awkward or ashamed for playful, mocking, or manipulative effect.

explanation_zh: 调侃某人因敏感言论或行为可能遭到惩罚。
meaning_en: Used jokingly to suggest that someone may get punished for making a risky or politically sensitive remark or doing something that could attract official trouble.
equivalent_en: that could get you in trouble
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: cancel culture is coming for you

explanation_zh: 赞美某人发言精彩，调侃可以整理成书。
meaning_en: It is a playful way to praise someone’s remarks as book-worthy, suggesting their comments are so sharp, funny, or insightful that people could crowdfund publishing them as a book.
distractor_pragmatic_neighbor_en: shut up and take my money

explanation_zh: 看到打雷场景时，用仙侠“渡劫”设定来调侃。
meaning_en: Used when seeing thunder or lightning, this meme jokingly frames the scene as if some cultivator nearby is undergoing a heavenly tribulation.
equivalent_en: which cultivator is undergoing heavenly tribulation here
distractor_literal_en: which Daoist friend is ferrying a disaster here
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: Zeus must be throwing lightning bolts

explanation_zh: 调侃犯错后把责任推给他人或环境。
meaning_en: This meme jokingly describes someone who, after making a mistake, shifts the blame onto other people or the surrounding situation instead of admitting their own fault.
distractor_literal_en: there are bad people among the masses

term_zh: 神经病啊我不要面子啊
explanation_zh: 遇到丢脸或离谱情况时的无奈吐槽。
meaning_en: A joking complaint used when facing an absurd or embarrassing situation, expressing helpless annoyance as if saying the situation is making them lose face.
equivalent_en: have some respect for my dignity
distractor_literal_en: are you crazy, do I not need face

explanation_zh: 委婉调侃某人该运动或减肥。
meaning_en: A teasing, indirect way to suggest that someone could use some exercise or weight loss, phrased like a casual sales pitch for swimming or gym membership.
equivalent_en: Can I interest you in a gym membership?
distractor_literal_en: swimming and fitness, learn about it

explanation_zh: 讽刺假冒名人、编造离奇故事骗钱的网络骗局。
meaning_en: It mocks an obviously fake money scam where someone pretends to be a famous or extraordinary figure and invents an absurd story to trick people into sending money.
distractor_literal_en: I am Qin Shi Huang paying money

explanation_zh: 调侃式发誓手势，被当作“真爱标准”。
meaning_en: A meme oath gesture for joking sincerity, used playfully to swear something is true or heartfelt and often treated online as a humorous standard for proving “true love.”
equivalent_en: a joking meme oath gesture to prove true love

explanation_zh: 提醒接下来的内容很重要，需要注意。
meaning_en: Used to call attention to what follows, as if highlighting a key point in class, meaning that the next information is important and should be noticed carefully.
distractor_literal_en: knock on the blackboard and underline the key points

explanation_zh: 发表敏感言论后，调侃赶紧收拾贵重物品跑路。
meaning_en: A joking phrase used after someone makes a politically or socially risky comment, implying they should quickly pack their valuables and run away before facing possible consequences.

explanation_zh: 假装同情，实际带调侃或忍笑意味。
meaning_en: It expresses mock sympathy while trying not to laugh, often pretending to console someone while actually teasing them or finding their misfortune funny.
equivalent_en: mock sympathy while trying not to laugh
distractor_literal_en: please allow me to be sad

explanation_zh: 演技好到改变观众对演员外貌或角色的看法。
meaning_en: Acting so good it transforms the actor’s appeal, making viewers see the performer’s looks, charm, or role in a completely different and often much more attractive light.
equivalent_en: acting so good it changes how viewers see the actor

term_zh: 劈个叉都是爱你的形状
explanation_zh: 调侃无论做什么都能被解释成“爱你的形状”。
meaning_en: It jokingly means that even a random action, such as doing a split, can be exaggerated or interpreted as “the shape of loving you,” turning anything into a playful sign of affection.
equivalent_en: anything can be spun as a sign of loving you
distractor_literal_en: the split is a heart shape

explanation_zh: 九头蛇组织口号，用于识别成员或玩梗式效忠。
meaning_en: “Long live Hydra” is the iconic Hydra loyalty slogan, used to signal allegiance to the organization or jokingly role-play as a loyal member in meme contexts.

explanation_zh: 表示自己的想法被别人抢先说了。
meaning_en: Used when joking that someone stole your comment idea by saying exactly what you were about to say first, leaving you with nothing original to add.
distractor_literal_en: delete it and let me say it

explanation_zh: 日式校园文化节，常见于 ACG 校园情节。
meaning_en: A Japanese-style school cultural festival, often seen in anime, comics, and games as a campus event where students run performances, food stalls, exhibits, or class activities.

explanation_zh: 同人或改编中角色行为偏离原作设定。
meaning_en: “OOC” means acting out of character, usually when a character in fan works or adaptations behaves in ways that conflict with their established personality, motivations, or canon portrayal.

explanation_zh: ACG/游戏中被作者或官方明显偏爱的角色。
meaning_en: A character favored by the creator or developers is one who receives obvious preferential treatment in a work, game, or franchise, often getting stronger abilities, better story focus, or more support than other characters.

explanation_zh: 特指表面谈吐体面、举止克制，私下热衷于擦边、猎奇、色向内容，带有隐秘特殊癖好的爱好者
meaning_en: An ironic ACG fandom term for someone who appears refined and restrained in public but privately enjoys suggestive, fetishistic, bizarre, or erotic content, essentially a “cultured pervert.”

term_zh: 你为什么不问问神奇海螺呢
explanation_zh: 调侃对方不愿自己找答案，表示不想回答。
meaning_en: This phrase jokingly tells someone to consult a magical source instead, teasing them for asking others a question they could have looked up or figured out themselves.
equivalent_en: why don’t you ask the Magic Conch
distractor_literal_en: why don’t you ask the magic sea snail

explanation_zh: 吐槽或规劝对方不要太恶意、太离谱。
meaning_en: It means begging someone to act like a decent person, usually as a complaint or warning when their behavior feels too malicious, outrageous, unreasonable, or lacking basic consideration.
equivalent_en: please be a decent human being
distractor_literal_en: I beg you to become a person

explanation_zh: 表示对方实力、地位不可动摇，仍然很强。
meaning_en: It is used to praise someone as still powerful and untouchable, emphasizing that their strength, status, or authority remains unshaken no matter how much time passes or others try to challenge them.
equivalent_en: the boss is still the boss
distractor_literal_en: your uncle will always be your uncle
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: the old master is still strong

term_zh: 我不尴尬尴尬的就是别人
explanation_zh: 只要自己不觉得尴尬，尴尬的就是别人。
meaning_en: It means refusing to feel embarrassed yourself, acting as if nothing is awkward, and thereby making the discomfort fall on other people instead.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: fake it till you make it

explanation_zh: 自我安慰，不和让人生气的人或事计较。
meaning_en: It means calming oneself down instead of insulting someone, choosing to let go of anger and not argue with or dwell on an irritating person or situation.
equivalent_en: I’ll let it go instead of insulting them

explanation_zh: 夸赞某人操作、表现很精彩，也可反讽。
meaning_en: It is used to praise someone for an impressive, skillful, or unexpectedly brilliant performance, often suggesting that their move or display was so good it left others amazed.

explanation_zh: 讽刺利用他人悲剧、不幸来牟利或博关注。
meaning_en: It refers to cynically exploiting another person’s tragedy or misfortune for personal gain, attention, traffic, or profit, especially by turning someone else’s suffering into a tool for benefit.
equivalent_en: exploiting someone else's tragedy for clout or profit

term_zh: 停靠在八楼的二路汽车
explanation_zh: 刀郎歌词梗，指乌鲁木齐“八楼”站相关文化记忆。
meaning_en: A lyric-based cultural reference to Urumqi’s Balou bus stop, evoking shared memories tied to Dao Lang’s song and the local image of a Route 2 bus stopping at Balou.
equivalent_en: the No. 2 bus stopping at Balou
distractor_literal_en: the No. 2 bus stopping on the eighth floor

explanation_zh: 反讽看起来阴森、威胁或充满敌意的眼神。
meaning_en: It refers to an ironically “kind” but actually threatening look, used sarcastically to describe eyes or a stare that seem sinister, hostile, or intimidating rather than genuinely friendly.

explanation_zh: 幸灾乐祸、恶作剧得逞或笑得很坏。
meaning_en: It describes a smile that gradually shifts from ordinary amusement into a mischievous, wicked, or gloating expression, often when someone enjoys another person’s misfortune or a prank has succeeded.

explanation_zh: 劝人低调积累实力，不要冒进或炫耀。
meaning_en: It advises someone to play safe, build strength quietly over time, and don’t get reckless by rushing ahead, showing off, or taking unnecessary risks before they are ready.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: stay low and avoid risky moves

explanation_zh: 调侃对方因一点成绩而自大。
meaning_en: This phrase is used to tease someone for getting cocky after a small success, implying they have become overly self-important or inflated with pride.

explanation_zh: 得意、自满，也可自嘲。
meaning_en: It means getting cocky or full of oneself, often because things are going well, and can also be used jokingly to mock one’s own overconfidence or inflated sense of importance.

explanation_zh: 夸张称赞某人很有才华，前途很好。
meaning_en: It jokingly praises someone as so talented and promising that they could casually choose between the most prestigious universities.
equivalent_en: Harvard or MIT, take your pick

term_zh: 我怀疑你在偷窥我的生活
explanation_zh: 对方描述过于准确，像是在窥视自己的生活。
meaning_en: This phrase expresses feeling personally exposed when someone’s description is so accurate and relatable that it seems as if they have been secretly watching your own life.
distractor_literal_en: I suspect you are peeping at my life
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: you described my life too accurately

term_zh: 你是不是在我家装了监控
explanation_zh: 对方说中自己现状，像装了监控一样。
meaning_en: It is a joking way to say that someone has described your current situation so accurately that it feels as if they secretly know everything about your life.
equivalent_en: How did you know exactly what I'm going through
distractor_literal_en: Did you install a home security system at my place

explanation_zh: 表面说不在乎钱，实际很在意钱。
meaning_en: It describes someone claiming that money is not important or that they do not care about it, while in reality being very concerned with money and strongly motivated by financial gain.
equivalent_en: It’s not about the money—yeah, right
distractor_literal_en: money or no money, it does not matter

explanation_zh: 不同寿命角色之间的悲伤情节设定。
meaning_en: A tragic romance or bond between characters with different lifespans, emphasizing the sadness and inevitability of separation when one character will age, die, or disappear much sooner than the other.

explanation_zh: 沉迷氪金抽卡、投入大量时间金钱却常无收获的玩家。
meaning_en: An Aji person is a gacha-addicted player who keeps spending money and pulling for rewards, often investing huge amounts of time and cash while getting little or nothing worthwhile in return.

explanation_zh: 表达惊讶、愤怒、疑惑或调侃“太狠了”。
meaning_en: Used to react when something feels unexpectedly harsh, shocking, or savage, often expressing surprise, anger, confusion, or teasing admiration at how ruthless or intense it seems.

explanation_zh: 把不顺强行归咎于水逆，用来自我安慰或找借口。
meaning_en: It means forcibly blaming every setback or unlucky situation on Mercury retrograde, using it as a convenient excuse or a form of self-comfort when things go wrong.

explanation_zh: 网络空间也必须遵守法律法规，不能随意发布违法或不当内容。
meaning_en: The phrase means that the internet is not beyond the law: online spaces are still subject to legal rules, and people cannot freely post illegal, harmful, or improper content without consequences.
equivalent_en: the internet is not above the law
distractor_literal_en: the internet is not a courtroom
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: what happens in Vegas stays in Vegas

explanation_zh: 面对震撼或美好的事物时，自嘲词穷，只能简单感叹。
meaning_en: Used self-deprecatingly when someone is so impressed by something beautiful or amazing that they feel too speechless or uncultured to praise it properly, and can only offer a simple exclamation.
equivalent_en: I'm too uncultured to say anything but wow

explanation_zh: 表达甘愿追随、喜欢对方，甚至愿意被对方伤害或支配。
meaning_en: It means affectionately and willingly placing yourself in a vulnerable position toward someone you like, even accepting being targeted, hurt, controlled, or treated as their prey.
distractor_literal_en: You are Runtu and I am the badger
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: You are Romeo and I am Juliet

explanation_zh: 指对方正在挑衅、冒险或接近危险边缘。
meaning_en: It means warning someone that they are taking a dangerous risk, usually because their provocative or reckless behavior is pushing close to serious trouble or crossing a dangerous line.
distractor_literal_en: you are doing a fire trick

explanation_zh: 提醒别人仔细品味其中的深层含义或暗示。
meaning_en: It is used to ask someone to think carefully and savor the details, especially to notice a hidden meaning, implication, or subtle message beneath what was said.

explanation_zh: 吐槽视频在关键处截断，表示自己想看完整内容。
meaning_en: Used to complain when a video cuts off at the key moment, implying the viewer wants the complete clip shown instead of being denied the full content.
distractor_literal_en: am I short of this little bit of traffic

explanation_zh: 比赛打平后进入最终决胜局。
meaning_en: It refers to a decisive final tiebreaking round played after a match or series is tied, where the competitors enter one last round or game to determine the winner.

explanation_zh: 表示结果非常确定，不要再说“可能”。
meaning_en: It means the outcome is certain and there is no need to hedge with “maybe” or “possibly,” emphasizing that something should be stated confidently as a definite fact rather than a mere possibility.

term_zh: 全网无前任有也不承认
explanation_zh: 调侃感情上“无牵无挂”，即使有前任也不承认。
meaning_en: It jokingly means presenting oneself online as having no romantic baggage or ex-partners, and even if past relationships existed, refusing to admit them publicly.
equivalent_en: no exes, and if there were, I’d deny them
distractor_literal_en: no predecessors anywhere on the internet
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: what happens in Vegas stays in Vegas

explanation_zh: 某些行为一旦开始就会不断重复，难以停止。
meaning_en: It means that certain actions are either never tried at all, or once started, become endlessly repeated and difficult to stop.
equivalent_en: once you start, you can’t stop

explanation_zh: 指需要保护、守护的重要对象或自己人。
meaning_en: It refers to a person, ally, or important thing on one’s own side that is especially valuable and must be carefully protected or guarded.
equivalent_en: our critical asset to protect at all costs

explanation_zh: 希望博主或喜欢的人回复自己的评论。
meaning_en: This phrase means asking or hoping that a creator, blogger, or admired person will notice one’s comment and respond, usually as a playful request for attention or acknowledgment.
equivalent_en: please notice and reply to my comment

explanation_zh: 面无表情、情绪不外露的冷淡表情。
meaning_en: A blank and unreadable facial expression describes someone showing no visible emotion, keeping their face cold, still, or expressionless so others cannot easily tell what they are thinking or feeling.

explanation_zh: 因不了解完整事实，所以不轻易发表评价。
meaning_en: It means refusing to make a judgment or comment because the full facts are not yet known, emphasizing caution and fairness before forming an opinion about a situation.

explanation_zh: 讽刺作弊或开挂者像用巨大代价换来超强能力。
meaning_en: A mocking phrase suggesting someone gained unfair or overwhelming power, such as through cheating or hacks, as if they had traded a terrible family tragedy for that ability.
distractor_literal_en: a heavenly ritual for boundless magic
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: made a deal with the devil

explanation_zh: 引出冒险、离谱、无耻或不合常理的想法。
meaning_en: This phrase is used to preface and draw attention to a risky or outrageous idea, often one that sounds absurd, shameless, unconventional, or likely to provoke a strong reaction.

explanation_zh: 某段内容、表演或氛围突然变得尴尬无效。
meaning_en: The whole bit or scene falls apart when a section of content, performance, or atmosphere suddenly becomes awkward, ineffective, or unable to keep working as intended.

explanation_zh: 讽刺观念陈旧、盲目吹捧他国并贬低本土的人。
meaning_en: An outdated public-intellectual type blindly praising foreign things, used sarcastically for people with stale views who idealize other countries while reflexively belittling their own society.

explanation_zh: 吐槽游戏里打火机燃料无限、设定不科学。
meaning_en: A joke about a lighter in a game that appears to have unlimited fuel, as if it were powered forever, used to mock an unrealistic or scientifically absurd game setting.

explanation_zh: 女骑士败北后说“杀了我吧”的 ACG 梗，表示宁死不屈。
meaning_en: It refers to the ACG trope where a defeated female knight defiantly says “just kill me,” expressing proud refusal to surrender or submit even after losing.

explanation_zh: 因愤怒、震惊等睁大眼睛，像哈士奇表情。
meaning_en: A wide-eyed angry or shocked expression like a husky, used to describe someone staring with exaggeratedly opened eyes because they are furious, startled, or stunned.

explanation_zh: 对“好起来了”的反向玩梗，用于调侃局势变坏或反向嘲讽优势局。
meaning_en: “Things are ironically going bad” is used to jokingly flip optimistic phrasing, mocking a situation that is deteriorating or sarcastically commenting that an apparent advantage is turning into a problem.

explanation_zh: 表示局势改善、取得优势，也可反向调侃劣势局。
meaning_en: “Things are finally improving” is used when a situation starts getting better or someone gains an advantage, often sincerely but also sarcastically to mock a still-bad or losing position.

explanation_zh: “行吧”的拆字表达，表示无奈妥协。
meaning_en: This meme expresses reluctant acceptance or compromise, used when someone feels resigned, has little choice, and agrees with a situation or suggestion despite not being fully willing or satisfied.

term_zh: 我想把这玩意儿染成绿的
explanation_zh: 想靠染绿变酷吸引异性，但带“绿帽”文化反讽。
meaning_en: It jokes about dyeing something green to seem cooler and more attractive, while ironically invoking the cultural association of green with being cuckolded or wearing a “green hat.”
equivalent_en: dye it green for rizz, with green-hat cuckold irony
distractor_literal_en: I want to dye this thing green
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: paint it green for St. Patrick's Day

explanation_zh: 原为诗句，网络中可指清纯难忘的爱人或暗号。
meaning_en: This phrase is used online as a poetic, subtle romantic reference, suggesting a pure and unforgettable love or serving as a quiet coded signal between people.
equivalent_en: the moon is beautiful, isn’t it
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: a rose by any other name

explanation_zh: 调侃网友评论犀利、不按套路出牌。
meaning_en: This phrase jokingly means that today’s netizens are too sharp and unpredictable, often responding with witty, cutting, or unexpected comments that make them hard to guide or fool.
distractor_literal_en: this batch of netizens is hard to lead

explanation_zh: 夸张调侃某人的背部好看或吸引人。
meaning_en: It jokingly praises someone’s back as especially good-looking or attractive, using an exaggerated image to express playful admiration for how appealing their back looks.
equivalent_en: that back is so good-looking it’s made for cupping
distractor_literal_en: this back is ideal for medical fire cupping

explanation_zh: 表示金钱、情绪、精力等已经完全耗尽。
meaning_en: This meme means being completely drained of money, emotion, energy, or other resources, to the point of having absolutely nothing left to give.
equivalent_en: I’ve got nothing left in the tank
distractor_literal_en: I literally have no drops of liquid left

term_zh: 忍一时卵巢囊肿退一步乳腺增生
explanation_zh: 调侃女性不要长期压抑情绪，应适当表达不满。
meaning_en: A joking warning that women should not keep suppressing frustration or anger, because bottling up emotions is humorously framed as harming their health, so they should express dissatisfaction when needed.
distractor_literal_en: endure once and get an ovarian cyst, step back and get breast hyperplasia

explanation_zh: 不经历生育和抚养，却对偶像或角色产生母性保护欲。
meaning_en: Feeling motherly affection and protectiveness toward an idol or fictional character while enjoying the emotional role of being a “mom” without experiencing childbirth, caregiving, or real parenting responsibilities.

term_zh: 我起了一枪秒了有什么好说的
explanation_zh: 游戏中被一枪秒杀后无奈自嘲，无话可说。
meaning_en: It expresses resigned self-mockery after being instantly killed by a single shot in a game, meaning there is nothing left to explain or argue about.
equivalent_en: Got one-tapped, what can I say?
distractor_literal_en: I fired one shot, what is there to say

explanation_zh: 将其他作品的情节、设定或亮点拼接进自己的作品。
meaning_en: It refers to blending borrowed tropes or plot elements from other works into one’s own creation, often by stitching together recognizable plots, settings, character dynamics, or standout ideas from existing media.
equivalent_en: stitching borrowed tropes into one’s own work

explanation_zh: 模仿过度愤怒发言，用于讽刺夸张反应。
meaning_en: This meme imitates an overly furious reaction to mock people who respond with exaggerated outrage, treating their anger as performative, melodramatic, or far beyond what the situation deserves.

explanation_zh: 用来调侃语文阅读、文字赏析的强行拔高、过度脑补
meaning_en: Used to mock forced literary analysis or exaggerated interpretation, where someone reads profound symbolism into ordinary wording or details that were never meant to be that deep.

explanation_zh: 调侃乱说话的人应接受夸张惩罚或苦差事。
meaning_en: It jokingly means that someone who made a foolish or inappropriate comment should be sent away to endure an exaggerated punishment or unpleasant hardship as playful social teasing.

term_zh: 千里送人头礼轻情意重
explanation_zh: 调侃主动送上门被对方轻松击败。
meaning_en: It jokingly describes someone going out of their way to approach an opponent, only to be defeated effortlessly and effectively hand them a free kill.
distractor_literal_en: send a human head a thousand miles as a heartfelt gift

explanation_zh: 指上班或表演时严重偷懒、划水。
meaning_en: This meme describes someone slacking off badly at work or during a performance, doing the bare minimum, avoiding real effort, and clearly failing to contribute as expected.

explanation_zh: 稳定军心、鼓励坚持，但常被当作不可靠 flag。
meaning_en: “Hold steady, we can still win” is used to encourage people to stay calm and keep pushing through, though it is often treated jokingly as an unreliable optimistic claim that may jinx the outcome.
equivalent_en: Hold steady, we can still win
distractor_literal_en: stabilize us and we can win

explanation_zh: 表达极度兴奋、激动或得意忘形。
meaning_en: It describes someone being extremely hyped or excited, so energized by joy, thrill, or pride that they seem carried away and unable to contain their enthusiasm.
distractor_literal_en: so high it can't go on

explanation_zh: 调侃视频审核中把血液改成绿色等颜色。
meaning_en: It mockingly refers to video censorship practices that recolor blood into green or other unnatural colors to make violent scenes appear less graphic or pass content review.

explanation_zh: 形容外貌甜美、皮肤白皙泛粉、少女感强的人。
meaning_en: It describes someone with a sweet, peach-like beauty, usually marked by a soft youthful look, fair skin with a rosy glow, and an overall gentle, fresh, and charming appearance.

explanation_zh: 表示“你听听，这是人说的话吗”，用于震惊或吐槽。
meaning_en: It is used to express shock or mockery by asking whether what someone just said can even be considered reasonable human speech.

term_zh: 太阳能维修月亮可更换
explanation_zh: 俏皮温柔的无厘头表达，传达浪漫与生活趣味。
meaning_en: A whimsical bit of nonsense used as cute romantic language, playfully suggesting impossible everyday services to create a gentle, affectionate mood and a sense of charming absurdity.
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: the moon is made of cheese

term_zh: 柠檬树上柠檬果柠檬树下你和我
explanation_zh: 表达因羡慕嫉妒而酸溜溜的心理。
meaning_en: This phrase jokingly describes people feeling jealous and “sour” when seeing something they envy, turning that bitter, envious reaction into a playful shared meme.
distractor_literal_en: lemons on the lemon tree, you and me under it

explanation_zh: 形容人或物非常优秀、罕见、出色。
meaning_en: It describes a person or thing as exceptionally good, rare, and outstanding, suggesting they are of unusually high quality and stand out from ordinary examples.

explanation_zh: 指强壮手臂或因刺激产生的冲动，带网络调侃意味。
meaning_en: A joking term for a powerful or uncontrollable arm, used online to tease someone’s strong arm or a sudden impulsive urge as if their arm has taken on exaggerated force.
equivalent_en: a jokingly overpowered or uncontrollable arm

term_zh: 团战可以输提莫必须死
explanation_zh: 游戏中表达对提莫的强烈怨念，宁可输团也要杀提莫。
meaning_en: This phrase expresses intense in-game resentment toward Teemo, meaning players are willing to lose a team fight as long as Teemo is killed.
equivalent_en: Lose the team fight if you must, but Teemo must die
distractor_literal_en: Teemo can lose the team fight

explanation_zh: 对比赛 BP 策略失误的质疑。
meaning_en: This meme is used to question a team’s draft strategy, specifically asking why they failed to ban a key champion that posed an obvious threat in the match.

explanation_zh: 调侃过去无可奈何，现在想改变或重新选择。
meaning_en: Used jokingly to say that in the past I had no real choice and could only accept things, but now I want to change direction and choose a different path.
equivalent_en: I had no choice back then, but now I want to choose differently
distractor_literal_en: Back then, I had no selection button
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: May the Force be with me

explanation_zh: 对作品或操作表示极高敬佩，夸张到“跪着看”。
meaning_en: It means showing extreme respect or admiration for someone’s work, skill, or operation, exaggerating that the viewer is so impressed they would use the computer while kneeling.
equivalent_en: I'm kneeling in awe at this
distractor_cultural_mismatch_en: shut up and take my money

explanation_zh: 用“正常现象”式说法讽刺异常事件频发。
